newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTIKO 20 MLN EEK SHARE ISSUE STARTS.
newsitem.headline: ESTIKO 20 MLN EEK SHARE ISSUE STARTS.

text.p: Estiko, a plastics and packaging company and retailer, will begin its 20 million kroon share issue on Thursday and the issue is expected to be over subscribed.
"We expect the share issue to be slightly over subscribed," Indrek Rahumaa, Head of Baltic Cresco's corporate Finance department, which is handling the issue, told Reuters.
"The stock will appeal to local investors more than foreign investors as the compnay's current structure is complicated and locals have more information on the company," he added.
Baltic Cresco will not be giving any presentations on the share issue abroad, Rahumaa said.

Estiko's share issue will run until May 8 and the 500,000 E shares on offer will have a nominal value of 10 kroons and a sale price of 40 kroons. The company is listed on the free market of the Tallinn stock exchange.

In an earlier interview to Reuters, the President of Estiko, Kalju Hellenurm, said that the main reason for the issue was to finance the construction of a 12-story business and commercial centre in Tartu.
"According to our review, and the central location of the site, the project is a good one compared to the existing Tartu kaubamaja store," Rahumaa said.
Tartu kaubamja is partly owned by Tallinna Kabamaja.

Estiko maunfactures plastic film for the food and packaging industry with exports to Finland, Sweden, Latvia, Lithuania and Ukraine. The company already owns a retail center in Tartu and operates a retail operation under the SPAR store name in Estonia.
